title: Lane-Emden Problems on Convex Domains of $\mathbb S^2$
summary: We study positive solutions of the Dirichlet problem $-Δu = u^p$ in a uniformly convex domain $Ω\subset \mathbb S^2$, $u= 0$ on $\partialΩ.$ For $p=1$, we assume that the right-hand side is replaced by $λ_1 u$, where $λ_1$ is the first eigenvalue of $-Δ$ on $Ω$ with zero Dirichlet boundary condition. We prove that for $0 \leq p < 1$ the unique positive solution $u$ is such that $u^{\frac{1-p}{2}}$ is strictly concave in $Ω$, while for $1 < p \leq 3$ every positive solution $u$ is such that $u^{\frac{1-p}{2}}$ is strictly convex in $Ω.$ For $p=0,$ our result gives the strict $1/2-$concavity…
